privacyLine: You see usernames + the values registrants gave {name}. AFC never shares account emails or phone numbers.

queueHint: Rejecting requires a reason. The player gets an email + an in-app notification with your reason and a prompt to re-enter the correct value; their resubmission returns here as pending.
reasonPlaceholder: e.g. This UID does not exist. Check the app and re-enter it.
alsoRemoveNote: Frees their slot so another player can register. They cannot resubmit.
toastRejected: {username} rejected. They get a notification with your reason and a prompt to re-enter the value.
toastRejectedRemoved: {username} rejected and removed from the event.
toastReasonRequired: A reason is required. It is sent to the player.
confirmRemove: Reject and REMOVE {username} from {event}? This frees their slot in the event.
